instruct: A small young woman with a low alto voice, rough-edged and earthy, slow confident delivery like she has all the time in the world. Deadpan humor with a grin behind it. Slightly husky, planted, zero softness or breathiness.

text: Relax. I've got the sky — had it for three thousand years, haven't dropped it once. Now come here and tell me where you've been standing.
